summary.intent: Bring PR #578 (WP L, publish isolation) up to date with latest main, verify the merged tree passes the full gate, and push it without rebasing or force-pushing.
summary.outcome: Merged latest main into the WP L branch with one docs conflict resolved in docs/architecture/release.md, ran pre-push, lint, doc-check, test, workflow-contracts and ci (all exit 0), and pushed at a151d249 with the remote ref matching. The lead was notified and work is idle until #578 merges.

repo: The project uses `just` recipes as gates: pre-push, lint, doc-check, test, workflow-contracts, and ci. workflow-contracts checks that workflow templates and policy rules agree.
Changes to workflow-related code on main (#576, #577, #581) warrant re-running the full gate on the merged tree, even when they merge without conflicts.

docs/architecture/release.md is a conflict hotspot: #582 changed `[release] targets` and `asset-name` wording, while L changed text about registry publishing running each npm package manager's `pack`.
The matrix `execute` job template is shared between #578 and the pending token-mapping PR (finding 01M7QS45H578), so the two PRs must be sequenced rather than stacked.
Builds are run with CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0, CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 and CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 to reduce build cost.
workflow: Merge main into the branch and push normally, with no rebase or force-push. Verify the push by comparing `git rev-parse HEAD` to `git ls-remote` output.
When a long gate (`just ci`) outlasts the foreground timeout, wait for the background task's exit code rather than starting a second copy.
Mutation tests can be skipped after a merge when the merge brought in no new code from the branch's own work package.
Use a worktree-per-work-package flow where PRs on the same template are not stacked and the next one starts after the previous merges. Report the pushed sha to the lead via SendMessage.

friction: `just ci` exceeded the foreground command timeout and had to be handled as a background task.
Merge conflict in docs/architecture/release.md required manually reconciling wording from #582 and WP L.
open_items: Token-mapping PR for the matrix `execute` job (finding 01M7QS45H578), including trusted-publishing docs and a changeset, is blocked until #578 merges.
docs/publishing.md wording about `url` and `@scope:registry` is to be added in the token-mapping PR.
Mutation tests were not re-run after the merge; they were judged unnecessary because no new L code came in.
Waiting for #578 to merge before any further work.
